senses.gloss: m. (פִּרְכֵּס II) jerking motion, struggling, spasmodic movement, as a symptom of vitality.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 38a:1">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>הרי זה פ׳</he> these are symptoms of vitality (proving that the slaughtered animal was not on the point of dying a natural death).
<cite ref="Chullin 38a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ שאמרו בתחלת שחיטה</he> the symptoms of vitality of which they speak refer to the beginning of the slaughtering act.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16a:14">Ab. Zar. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>חיה … בהמה דקה לפ׳</he> a large beast of chase is like a small domestic animal as regards the symptoms of vitality required at slaughtering; a. e.
